title: Austin Deliberates Equity, Land Rights, Lawsuit
summary:
*   **Affirmative Action Goals**: Discussions were held regarding the city's affirmative action goal-setting process.
*   **Property Rights & City Growth**: Officials reviewed proposed legislation concerning municipal annexation and vested property rights.
*   **Legal Battle Update**: Received an update on the ongoing lawsuit, FM Properties Operating Co. v. City of Austin.
